text: Agents are autonomous units that perform tasks, make decisions based on role/goal, and use tools to accomplish objectives
quote: In the CrewAI framework, an `Agent` is an autonomous unit that can: * Perform specific tasks * Make decisions based on its role and goal * Use tools to accomplish objectives

text: Tasks are specific assignments with a description, responsible agent, required tools, and other execution details
quote: a `Task` is a specific assignment completed by an `Agent`. Tasks provide all necessary details for execution, such as a description, the agent responsible, required tools

text: Tasks can run sequentially in defined order or hierarchically assigned to agents by role/expertise
quote: Tasks can be executed in two ways: **Sequential**: Tasks are executed in the order they are defined * **Hierarchical**: Tasks are assigned to agents based on their roles and expertise

text: Flows let you build structured, event-driven workflows that connect tasks, manage state, and control execution
quote: Flows allow you to create structured, event-driven workflows. They provide a seamless way to connect multiple tasks, manage state, and control the flow of execution in your AI applications.

text: Flows combine and coordinate coding tasks with Crews into more sophisticated automations
quote: Flows allow developers to combine and coordinate coding tasks and Crews efficiently, providing a robust framework for building sophisticated AI automations.

text: Unified Memory class replaces short/long-term/entity/external memory with one API using adaptive recall via composite scoring
quote: CrewAI provides a **unified memory system** -- a single `Memory` class that replaces separate short-term, long-term, entity, and external memory types with one intelligent API.

text: Memory uses an LLM to analyze content when saving, inferring scope, categories, and importance automatically
quote: CrewAI provides a **unified memory system** -- a single `Memory` class... Memory uses an LLM to analyze content when saving (inferring scope, categories, and importance)

text: Built-in tools give agents capabilities like web search, data analysis, and delegating tasks to other agents
quote: CrewAI tools empower agents with capabilities ranging from web searching and data analysis to collaboration and delegating tasks among coworkers

text: Integrates with multiple LLM providers via their native SDKs so you can pick the right model for your use case
quote: CrewAI integrates with multiple LLM providers through providers native sdks, giving you the flexibility to choose the right model for your specific use case.

text: An official CLI lets you create, train, run, and manage crews and flows
quote: The CrewAI CLI provides a set of commands to interact with CrewAI, allowing you to create, train, run, and manage crews & flows.

text: The `crewai test` CLI command runs a crew for a set number of iterations and reports detailed performance metrics
quote: We added the CLI command `crewai test` to make it easy to test your crew. This command will run your crew for a specified number of iterations and provide detailed performance metrics.

text: Agents can connect to MCP servers directly via an `mcps` field, supporting quick string references or full structured configs
quote: CrewAI offers **two approaches** for MCP integration: ### 🚀 **Simple DSL Integration** (Recommended) Use the `mcps` field directly on agents for seamless MCP tool integration.

text: Performance monitoring tracks agent execution times, token usage, and resource consumption
quote: Track agent execution times, token usage, and resource consumption

text: Tracing and observability features monitor agents and workflows in real time, including metrics, logs, and traces
quote: Tracing & Observability: Monitor and track your AI agents and workflows in real-time, including metrics, logs, and traces.

text: A Visual Agent Builder lets you design and configure agents via a no-code, form-based interface with real-time testing
quote: CrewAI AMP includes a Visual Agent Builder that simplifies agent creation and configuration without writing code. Design your agents visually and test them in real-time.

text: A Visual Task Builder supports drag-and-drop task creation with visual dependency mapping and real-time validation
quote: The Visual Task Builder enables: Drag-and-drop task creation, Visual task dependencies and flow, Real-time testing and validation

text: Crews can be deployed to managed infrastructure with a few clicks
quote: Deploy your crews to a managed infrastructure with a few clicks

text: Deployed crews expose a REST API for integrating with existing systems
quote: Access your deployed crews via REST API for integration with existing systems

text: The official CLI is installed via `uv tool install crewai`
quote: Run the following command to install crewai CLI: uv tool install crewai

text: A crew is a collaborative group of agents that work together, with a defined strategy for task execution and collaboration
quote: A crew in crewAI represents a collaborative group of agents working together to achieve a set of tasks. Each crew defines the strategy for task execution, agent collaboration, and the overall workflow.

text: The CLI can scaffold a new crew, flow, tool, skill, or template project from a template
quote: Create a new crew, flow, tool, skill, or template project.

text: Webhook streaming pushes real-time events and updates to external systems
quote:
Webhook Streaming

Stream real-time events and updates to your systems

text: Crew Studio provides a no-code/low-code interface for creating and customizing crews
quote: Create and customize crews using a no-code/low-code interface

text: A Tool Repository lets you publish and install tools to extend crew capabilities
quote:
Tool Repository

Publish and install tools to enhance your crews’ capabilities

text: YAML-based agent configuration supports version control of agent settings and easy switching between models
quote: The YAML configuration allows you to: * Version control your agent settings * Easily switch between different models

text: Crews and Flows give developers autonomous multi-agent collaboration plus precise, event-driven control
quote: It gives developers autonomous agent collaboration through Crews and precise, event-driven control through Flows.
